question: For the same predeclared button, touch, and approach inputs, does coupling a bounded hormone-inspired AHM to the SO(2) CPG change mean servo-command total variation without increasing median source-to-command onset latency by more than 0.10 s, compared with a fixed-parameter CPG?
hypothesis: In the proposed model, AHM-to-CPG coupling will reduce mean per-step servo-command total variation by at least 10% versus C0, while the paired median source-to-command onset latency is no more than 0.10 s slower. These are prospective decision thresholds, not observed results; evaluate both with paired trials and report all missing outcomes.
biological_inspiration_source: Conceptual inspiration: hormone-mediated modulation of locomotion in the adaptive locomotion architecture of Ngamkajornwiwat et al. (2020), IEEE Access 8, 91587-91602, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2020.2992794. The project is not a reproduction of that paper's MNLC, hormone equations, terrain adaptation, or results. The Week04 course AHM equation is used as an explicitly proposed teaching model.
AHM_equation: Course-model discrete update: R_old=clamp((H_old-H_min)/(H_max-H_min),0,1); P=k_prod*S; C=k_clear*H_old; B=k_bind*R_old; H_new=clamp(H_old+dt*(P-C-B),0,1); R_new=H_new. This is the Week04 proposed course model, not a claim that the paper uses this exact equation. H and S are dimensionless; P,C,B are normalized-H/s.
SO2_CPG_equation: Use the Week03 simultaneous recurrence: a1_next=alpha*(cos(phi)*o1+sin(phi)*o2); a2_next=alpha*(-sin(phi)*o1+cos(phi)*o2); o1_next=tanh(a1_next); o2_next=tanh(a2_next). Read both old outputs before updating either. Source attribution: Week03 course handout, citing legacy lec5.pptx slide 18; alpha/phi and the proposed mapping below require validation and are not certified hardware values.
integration_description: Map the new receptor value to phi=clamp(0.20+0.20*R,0.10,0.45) rad and amplitude_scale=0.75+0.25*R. CPG outputs drive bounded semantic servo targets in [tilt,extend,nod] order; the FSM remains responsible for event/state priority and the CPG modulates only the expressive motion component. Convert RGB channels to [0,1] by integer/255 with alpha=1.0. No hormone state directly commands a motor.
independent_variable: AHM-to-SO(2)-CPG coupling: disconnected fixed CPG (C0) versus bounded receptor-to-phase/amplitude mapping (C1).

conditions.name: C0
conditions.change: Fixed CPG parameters alpha=1.10 and phi=0.20 rad; compute and log the same AHM state as C1 but do not feed it into CPG parameters.

conditions.name: C1
conditions.change: Connect the same AHM receptor R to phi=clamp(0.20+0.20*R,0.10,0.45) rad and amplitude_scale=0.75+0.25*R; change no other factor.

metrics.name: mean_servo_command_total_variation
metrics.measurement: For the three commanded radian channels, sum abs(q[j]-q[j-1]) over adjacent samples and channels, divide by the number of intervals; calculate per trial over the declared active-input window. Also retain channel-wise values.
metrics.missing_rule: A trial without a complete timestamped command trace is missing, never zero; retain trial ID and reason and do not replace it. Report all three repeats and paired differences.

metrics.name: source_to_servo_onset_latency
metrics.measurement: For each predeclared expected input ID, subtract the input source event time from the first servo command change >=0.02 rad; report simulation command onset separately from real-robot measured physical onset.
metrics.missing_rule: If no qualifying command/physical onset occurs in the observation window, record missing/censored with reason and retain in the denominator; do not substitute zero. Do not mix command and physical-onset measurements.

controls: Identical FSM transition table, input waveform and predeclared event IDs within each paired C0/C1 repeat.
Identical initial oscillator state, hormone initial state, dt, scheduler, bounds, RGB/state mapping and observation window.
Same robot, sensor placement, actuator limits, firmware/driver version and calibration for paired real-robot trials; log any deviation.

parameters.provenance: Week04 proposed course model; confirm against the project implementation before use.

simulation_plan: Implement the completed FSM, Week04 proposed AHM, Week03 simultaneous SO(2) recurrence and bounded servo decoder in a separate project branch/module. Run C0 and C1 for three paired seeds with identical source inputs and reset state. Log source input IDs/times, H/R, oscillator state, command outputs, configuration and source hashes. The present Lab07 offline runner only measures its own C0 ideal versus C1 modeled transport experiment; it does not implement this AHM/CPG comparison.
real_robot_plan: Not run in this workspace. Before any trial, identify the available robot/MCU/driver and ROS 2 Jazzy host; implement and bench-test the versioned seven-topic adapter, map semantic radian targets through measured linkage calibration, verify neutral pose/direction/bounds and emergency stop with actuators disabled, then conduct three paired C0/C1 repeats. Record source IDs, calibrated physical onset (encoder or synchronized video), sensor/driver configuration and failures. Do not treat ROS bag receipt as physical movement.
clock_correlation_plan: Attach a unique source input_id in the acquisition/logging wrapper and carry it in sidecar logs across source, controller decision, command and physical observation; the seven wire messages do not contain Header/input IDs. Use one host monotonic clock where possible. For MCU/host/video, record synchronization markers before and after each trial, estimate offset/drift and report a conservative error bound. If identity or clock uncertainty exceeds the predeclared tolerance, mark latency unavailable rather than infer it from message order.
safety_stop_plan: A named operator supervises every real-robot run and has an immediately reachable hardware E-stop. Start with actuators disabled; verify neutral, direction, per-joint bounds, rate limits and watchdog before enabling. Stop on unexpected motion, limit violation, stale sensor/command, communication loss, participant discomfort or any contact risk; disable torque/power as appropriate, preserve logs, and do not resume until the cause is reviewed.
order_counterbalancing: Use balanced order C0-C1, C1-C0, C0-C1 for the three paired blocks; keep the same seed/input schedule inside each pair. Reset and re-calibrate to the same neutral state between trials and record order, rest and any protocol deviation.
paired_seed_or_participant_plan: Simulation: pair seeds 41, 42, 43 across C0/C1. Real robot: use the same scripted input schedule and source IDs within each condition pair; if people provide inputs, obtain required consent and use participant IDs rather than names, with condition order counterbalanced and withdrawal/missing trials retained.
expected_input_ids_before_run: Predeclare button_01, touch_01, approach_01, clear_01, near_01, clear_02, button_02 as the primary expected set for the Lab07 supplied protocol. For the proposed AHM/CPG project, freeze the selected positive response IDs and mapping in a versioned protocol before collecting data; use the identical denominator for C0 and C1 and report the full source_outcomes, including misses.
timeline: Week 1: freeze question, protocol, input IDs, consent/safety review and interface graph. Week 2: implement AHM/CPG integration and unit tests; record code/config hashes. Week 3: run paired simulation pilot and verify metrics/missing rules without tuning on test outcomes. Week 4: bench calibration, safety checks and three paired real-robot trials per condition if hardware is available and approved. Week 5: run the 600 s human-interaction scenario under the approved protocol, analyze paired data and submit report, raw traces, manifest and deviations. Dates and hardware availability must be confirmed by the group/instructor.
